answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Work waits on the tide until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the glacier of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the velvet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
